description: The complete Indonesia income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: PPh 21 month by month with TER categories A/B/C and the December (or last month) reconciliation, per employer; PTKP by status and dependants, spouse's income combined (K/I), family vs separate (MT/PH) filing compared; Biaya jabatan and biaya pensiun with their caps; JHT, JP, DPLK and zakat through the employer; BPJS Ketenagakerjaan (JHT, JP, JKK, JKM) and Kesehatan, employee and employer, with the wage caps; Business: PP 55 final 0.5% with the Rp 500 million exemption, NPPN norm, bookkeeping with losses; the cheapest allowed; and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in IDR; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

inputSchema.description: An individual's income tax return for Indonesia, tax year 2026 (calendar year). Amounts in rupiah for the year unless stated; leave out what does not apply.

final_paid.description: PP 55 final tax already paid this year, rupiah

free_profession.description: Doctor, lawyer, accountant, consultant, notary, artist and similar: no PP 55

loss_brought_forward.description: Business losses of the last 5 years not yet used (bookkeeping), rupiah

method.description: auto (cheapest allowed, default), final05 (PP 55 final 0.5% above Rp 500 million), norma (deemed-profit norm, NPPN) or books (bookkeeping)

norma_pct.description: NPPN norm for the business and area as a fraction, e.g. 0.5 (PER-17/PJ/2015)

dependants.description: Dependants (relatives in a straight line and one adopted child), 0-3

donations.description: Donations under PP 93/2010 (disaster relief, research, education, sports, social infrastructure), rupiah

filing.description: Spouses: family (one NPWP, default) or separate (MT, chosen by the spouse, or PH, separate property). Both are compared

filing_date.description: Date the 2026 return is filed, YYYY-MM-DD (due 31 March 2027; later: Rp 100,000 fine)

final.description: Income taxed with final tax at source

dividends_reinvested.description: Part of those dividends reinvested in Indonesia in time (exempt; otherwise 10%), rupiah

land_rental.description: Rent from land and buildings (10%), rupiah

land_sale.description: Sale price of land and buildings (2.5%), rupiah

listed_shares_sold.description: Gross proceeds from selling listed shares (0.1%), rupiah

pension_lump_sum.description: Pension or JHT paid as a lump sum, rupiah

simple_house_sale.description: The sale is of a simple house or flat by a developer (1%)

foreign_expert.description: Foreign citizen expert in the first 4 years of residence: only Indonesian income is taxed

foreign_tax_paid.description: Tax paid abroad on that income, rupiah

items.description: A job with a permanent employer (pegawai tetap)

bonus.description: THR (religious holiday allowance) and bonuses for the year, rupiah

bonus_month.description: Month the bonus is paid, 1-12. Default 12

bpjs.description: Enrolled in BPJS Ketenagakerjaan and Kesehatan through this employer. Default true

jkk_rate.description: Employer JKK work-accident rate by risk class, 0.0024 to 0.0174. Default 0.0024

monthly_salary.description: Regular wage per month: salary plus fixed allowances (the BPJS wage base), rupiah

months.description: Months worked from start_month. Default to December

other_taxable.description: Other taxable pay and benefits in kind (natura) for the year, rupiah

pension_fund.description: Your contributions to an approved pension fund (DPLK) through the employer, per year, rupiah

withheld.description: PPh 21 withheld per the annual A1 slip (BPA1, formerly 1721-A1); leave out to have it computed (TER + December reconciliation), rupiah

zakat.description: Zakat paid through the employer, per year, rupiah

monthly_interest_rate.description: Monthly late-payment interest rate (UU KUP Art. 9(2b)) as a fraction, set each month by the Minister of Finance (KMK): use the one in force on 1 April 2027. Default 0.0102 (1.02%, KMK 52/MK/EF.2/2026, November 2026)

months_resident.description: Months in Indonesia in 2026 when part_year. Default 12

other_income.description: Other income taxed at the brackets (royalties, other interest, foreign dividends not reinvested), rupiah

pph22_23.description: PPh 22 and 23 withheld by clients, rupiah

part_year.description: Arrived from or left for abroad during 2026: income is annualised and the tax pro rata

payment_date.description: Date any balance due is paid, YYYY-MM-DD (after 31 March 2027: late-payment interest, part months count in full, max 24 months)

withheld.description: PPh 21 withheld; leave out to compute, rupiah

prior_year_net.description: Last year's net income, for the 5% donation limit (default: this year's), rupiah

residency.description: resident (in Indonesia more than 183 days in 12 months, or intending to stay) or nonresident (PPh 26). Default resident

bpjs.description: Spouse enrolled in BPJS. Default true

combine_salary.description: Spouse's salary is from more than one employer or from the family business: combined in the family return

other_income.description: Spouse's other net income (business, other), rupiah

treaty_rate.description: Non-residents: PPh 26 rate under a tax treaty, e.g. 0.1. Default 0.2

zakat.description: Zakat to BAZNAS/LAZ or compulsory religious contributions, not through the employer, rupiah
